lines.text: May the high praises of God be in their mouths,
and a double-edged sword in their hands,
to inflict vengeance on the nations
to bind their kings with chains
and their nobles with shackles of iron,
to execute the judgment written against them.
This honor is for all His saints.

pictures.scene: Bartolomé Bermejo, Saint Michael Triumphs over the Devil — the archangel in gold armour with the sword lifted over his head above the dragon, the high praises of God in their mouths and a double-edged sword in their hands
pictures.name: pd_bermejo_zwaard

pictures.scene: Raphael, The Expulsion of Heliodorus from the Temple — the two avengers coming down through the air with their rods raised and the horseman riding the robber down, to inflict vengeance on the nations and punishment on the peoples
pictures.name: pd_rafael_wraak

pictures.scene: Paolo Veronese, The Family of Darius before Alexander — the conquered royal house kneeling in the dust at the feet of the armoured victor, to bind their kings with chains and their nobles with shackles of iron
pictures.name: pd_veronese_ketenen

pictures.scene: Rogier van der Weyden, The Last Judgement — Saint Michael holding the balance steady between his two hands under the golden sphere, to execute the judgment written against them, this honor is for all His saints
pictures.name: pd_weyden_oordeel

pictures.scene: Pietro Perugino, The Ascension of Christ — Christ lifted into the rainbow mandorla with the angels playing harp and viol around Him and the apostles gazing up, Hallelujah
pictures.name: pd_perugino_halleluja
